data.scope: Three serial ABBA rounds for typed Value-boundary and direct canonical encoding separately; predecoded typed records; clone + scalar edit + exact durable encode. Direct mode requires a different internal host representation. Excludes VM, gateway, state admission and queueing. Not a complete typed broker architecture.

Three ABBA rounds over complete saved states: identity plus incoming/outgoing seal work, including proof write and match. Excludes VM, observation construction, cold restore, gateway and asynchronous load; not a complete single-turn replay.

Two sequential ABBA rounds and one 16-worker ABBA, prepared schema3 states and complete borrowed host calls including source admission, exact guards, seals, broker and VM. Both share source checks per wave. Three qualified scripts, synthetic authoritative-history inputs, 1000 distinct identities sharing one fixture account. Excludes preparing hosts/states, trigger, queue, gateway, journal and asynchronous load. VM elapsed scopes overlap in parallel mode and must not be subtracted from wall time. Not a replay of missing historical v14 artifacts.

duration.scope: 60-second observed clock windows; RSS least-squares slope includes retained durable journal growth

bot_durable_receipts.scope: bar-close-visible cohort; durable terminal receipts include drain; whole-run dispositions also retained
bot_durable_receipts.latency_definition: first successful clock publication crossing the actual new bar close to accepted action durable install

accepted_window_coverage.scope: 60-second bar-close-anchor cohorts; final remainder under 5 seconds merges into the prior window; accepted durable outcomes may complete after the cohort; gap includes measurement endpoints; admissions do not prove fills

diagnostics.scope: whole run including startup/warmup; nested cumulative wall times include waits and must not be summed
diagnostics.p95: power-of-two nanosecond histogram upper bound, not exact sample P95
diagnostics.worker_roundtrip: pipe send, Python decode/decision/encode, output receive; not interpreter-only CPU time
diagnostics.worker_acquire: affinity-slot wait plus cold process startup when needed
diagnostics.measurement_delta_scope: scheduled warmup-end through scheduled measurement-end metrics; excludes drain; P95/max remain cumulative values
